desc:
💪 Welcome to Lifting Simulator: Remastered! 💪

🤖 FREE AUTO TRAIN
Auto-train & auto-rejoin every 15 minutes. No autoclicker or macro needed!

✨ REMASTERED FEATURES
🏋️ Auto-equip your lifting tool when you join!
🌎 NO MORE SAFE ZONE — no more giants crowding one area and blocking your view!
🌴 LAW OF THE JUNGLE — only the strong survive. You get just 10s of ForceField protection after spawning!
📍 Stronger players spawn in different locations to reduce crowding from giants!
💸 Faster progression + much cheaper Passes & Boosts!
⚡ New Bosses & upgraded Skill visual effects!

💡 TIP: Huge weights blocking your view? Turn off Show Other Weights in Settings!

🏋️ Lift to Get Bigger & Stronger!
👑 Sell Muscle for Coins!
💰 Buy Stronger Weights!
⚡ Become Superhuman!
🐲 Defeat Gods, steal their Bloodlines & become one yourself!
🔱 Inherit God Races — Angels, Demons & more!
⚔️ Dethrone Champions from the leaderboards!
🏆 Become the Strongest and sit on the throne!

[ By Thai Devs Team 😊 ]
